_comment: Generated by scripts/export_flood_facts.py from the reports named in each 'source'. Do not edit by hand; tests fail if this drifts.

ground_truth.name: Sen1Floods11 LabelHand
ground_truth.what: hand-annotated water masks distributed with Sen1Floods11
ground_truth.unannotated_handling: Pixels labelled -1 are excluded from the loss and from every metric, in both the numerator and the denominator.
ground_truth.not_available_for: Real scenes run by SAT-AI (for example the Nepal Koshi scene of 2024-09-27) have no ground truth, so nothing produced on them has been scored.

model.name: flood_unet
model.output: one logit per pixel; sigmoid gives water probability

india_test.label: TEST: held-out India, 68 chips, never used for training or selection

mekong_validation.label: VALIDATION: Mekong, used to select the checkpoint. NOT a test score and NOT the India score.

otsu_india_test.label: TEST: classical Otsu baseline on the same 68 India chips

otsu.method: Otsu on Sentinel-1 VV, unimodality guard 0.66, no HAND mask

gate.compares: the scene's per-band pixel distributions against the training chips the model actually saw

steps: Find a Sentinel-1 acquisition over the study area in the Planetary Computer catalogue.
Read VV and VH over the area and convert linear backscatter to dB.
Compute the VV/VH ratio band (VV dB minus VH dB).
Run the distribution gate against the training chips.
Normalise each band with the training normaliser.
Predict in 512 px tiles with 64 px overlap, averaging overlaps.
Apply a sigmoid and threshold the probability to a water mask.
Write probability, mask and extent with the gate verdict attached.
